judge_pacing: Two dissimilar cases per request with at least 20 seconds between judge requests; 48-case Codex source review is retained separately for grader audit, pending independent human calibration.
execution: Direct production generate_answer path inside Oracle app container; read-only access to the deployed index and no interaction-log writes.
pacing: Initial answer run used three shards, each spaced at least 30 seconds between case starts (nominal 6 requests/minute combined). The remaining cases are resumed serially after the Gemini 500-request daily free-tier quota resets. Provider errors are kept separate from policy judgments.
retrieval_metric: Annotated source-document hit among production adaptive-depth retrieved chunks; this is weaker than policy-evidence sufficiency.
answer_metric: Resolved faculty expectation plus cited-source review with decomposed judgment; incomplete/provider-error cases are excluded from the accuracy denominator and reported explicitly.
